_doc: Feint: follows ATTACK_HIGH into its strike up to `swing`, stops, then pulls back only `retreat` of the way toward the cocked pose (hand fast, arm slow).

_help.like: uses this attack's raise and cock, then snaps back
_help.pull_back.lift: shoulder offset from the cocked pose at the end of the retreat (deg; negative = pulled back/up)
_help.pull_back.wrist: wrist offset at the end of the retreat (deg)
_help.jaw_after: jaw at the end of the retreat (0 shut .. 100 open): keeps the sword cocked if high
_help.captured.start: raised/cocked pose (real degrees): ATTACK_HIGH's cocked pose moved 30% toward its slam end, so the feint commits into the slam line before pulling back (40% brought the blade within 2.0 cm of an opponent resting blade as the jaw closes on the pull-back). Delete to use the attack's exact cocked pose.
_help.captured.end: end pose captured from the arm 2026-09-12 (real degrees): the rest pose (lift clamped from -89.7 to the -89 hard rule). Overrides pull_back. Delete the entry to go back to the computed pose.
_help.swing: how far into the attack's strike the feint goes before stopping (0 = stops at the cocked pose, 1 = full strike)
_help.t_back_fast: seconds for the wrist and jaw to pull back after the stop (fast is fine here)
_help.t_back_slow: seconds for the base, shoulder and elbow to settle back (slow = no visible jerk)
_help.retreat: how far the pull back goes, as a fraction of the way from the mid-swing stop back to the cocked pose (0.35 = slightly off, 1 = all the way)
_help.strike_slow: multiplier on the strike phase duration (1 = same speed as the attack, 1.6 = noticeably slower strike)
